# The five outputs of the 5-bit counter of the left array (sl0..sl4) from the wiring channel
# east of that array (trace/urch.txt, x 4720) to the comparator of R5 in the upper right datapath
# (trace/rdp1.txt): 9,000 px. Notes: notes/blocks/slbus.md.
# Each line is, west to east: poly, metal over the poly bus x 5000-5450 (pads at x 4925/4968 and
# 5615/5658), poly, metal (pads at x 6140-6196 and 7438-7494), poly through the central datapath's
# channel 2 (no contact there), metal with one or two corners at x 11180-11360 (pads at
# x 11020/11064), poly east. At x 11730-11930 all five step up one line position (nested bends,
# 3.3x view c5b.png), run on over the logic above the counters and end on the contact of one
# counter track of the R5 comparator.
@block slbus
@requires urch
@requires rdp1
@w M=20 P=18
@s 28x28

# sl3

P 4906,6481:4944,6515

P 5596,6481:5634,6515

P 5615,6498 x6152 w=18

M 6138,6498 x7496 w=20

P 11013,6481:11051,6515

P 11326,6628:11364,6662
C 11345,6645
P 11345,6645 x11760 y6605 x14670 w=18
